# IQ Mermaid

> IQ Mermaid is a free mermaid diagram editor — all it needs is an email to sign in. It has two synced views: a visual canvas (double-click to add a block, drag to connect) and a mermaid code editor, so you can build a diagram either way and get valid mermaid syntax out. It supports flowchart, sequence, class, ER, state, gantt, git graph and pie diagrams, and exports to SVG, PNG, .mmd or a fenced Markdown block. Sign-in is by an emailed one-time code; saved diagrams live in your account and sync across devices.

## Product

- [IQ Mermaid](https://iq-mermaid.com) — the editor: visual canvas and mermaid code side by side, right on the home page (no separate app URL).
- [Guides](https://iq-mermaid.com/blog) — mermaid syntax guides and how-tos.

## How it works

- Free with no paid tier; signing in only takes an email (no password, no credit card).
- Visual tab edits flowcharts directly; the mermaid code tab renders any diagram type mermaid supports.
- Paste existing mermaid code into the code tab — a flowchart is parsed back onto the canvas with nodes, shapes, colors and subgraphs intact; other diagram types render in preview but stay code-only.
- Diagrams are saved to your account as you work and are there when you come back on another device.
- Rendering happens client-side in the browser.
- Available in 34 languages.
